output.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date)::int AS fiscal_year, ROUND(SUM(net_revenue), 2) AS revenue_eur FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE is_revenue GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
output.explanation: Revenue is net_revenue of completed orders only (is_revenue = true), excluding shipping fees, cancelled, returned and open orders. Orders are grouped by calendar year of order_date, which is the fiscal year. Amounts are in EUR and rounded to 2 decimals.
